name: forgelink
description: ForgeLink is a private desktop bridge for controlled local computer access, engineering automation, and MCP Apps integration.
author: Vidit Shah

scripts.bundle:backend: vite build --config vite.backend.config.mjs && node scripts/prepare-pty.mjs && node scripts/prepare-typescript-lib.mjs
scripts.prepare:assets:common: npm run sync:branding && npm run build:artifact-ui && node scripts/prepare-icons.mjs && npm run bundle:backend && npm run build
scripts.package:win: node scripts/assert-native-target.mjs win32 && npm run prepare:assets:common && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs --platform=win32 && electron-forge package --platform win32
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/assert-native-target.mjs darwin && npm run prepare:assets:common && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs --platform=darwin && electron-forge package --platform darwin
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/assert-native-target.mjs linux && npm run prepare:assets:common && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs --platform=linux && electron-forge package --platform linux
scripts.make:win: node scripts/assert-native-target.mjs win32 && npm run prepare:assets:common && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs --platform=win32 && node scripts/make-native.mjs win32
scripts.make:mac: node scripts/assert-native-target.mjs darwin && npm run prepare:assets:common && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs --platform=darwin && node scripts/make-native.mjs darwin
scripts.make:linux: node scripts/assert-native-target.mjs linux && npm run prepare:assets:common && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs --platform=linux && node scripts/make-native.mjs linux
scripts.verify:desktop: node --test desktop/*.test.mjs && npm run test:safety && node verify-access.mjs && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.mjs
scripts.lint:desktop: node --check desktop/main.mjs && node --check desktop/preload.mjs && node --check desktop/renderer/src/main.js
